model.reference_estimator: translation-equivariant normalized LMS from completed ordinary packets

baseline_selection.auc: minimum geometric mean cumulative risk among resource-feasible baselines within each cell
baseline_selection.terminal: minimum geometric mean terminal risk among resource-feasible baselines within each cell

gates.O1: 9984 complete finite endpoints, 24 cells, and no excluded seed
gates.O2: every policy including oracle diagnostic uses exactly four environment transitions per launch
gates.O3: online policy average messages do not exceed each budget plus 1/launches
gates.O4: active-cell median terminal-risk improvement is at least 0.10
gates.O5: online policy strictly improves terminal risk in at least 0.80 of active cells and is not worse in any active cell
gates.O6: active-cell median cumulative-risk improvement is positive and strict improvement fraction is at least 0.80
gates.O7: median terminal improvement is positive in every nonzero coupling, delay, budget, and switch group
gates.O8: maximum absolute terminal and cumulative difference in uncoupled controls is at most 1e-12
gates.O9: minimum mean number of online graph supports over active cells is at least 5
gates.O10: all 24 strong baselines are present and feasibility precedes outcome-wise envelope selection
gates.O11: manifest status, source hash, estimator gain, and no-preexisting-output provenance are frozen
gates.O12: every active oracle denominator is positive and median online terminal-headroom recovery is at least 0.75
gates.O13: online endpoints contain finite estimator error and a 64-character action-trace hash
gates.O14: isolated rerun is byte-identical for endpoints, cells, and core summary

stopping_rule: any O1-O13 failure records an honest failure and forbids standard-MARL integration under this controller; O14 reproduces the same outcome without retuning
